description: This file implements the Create feature for comments in the application, handling creation, validation, and database persistence of new comments associated with articles.

classes.name: Create.Command
classes.description: Represents the command to create a new comment associated with an article, containing the model data and article slug.

classes.name: Create.Model
classes.description: Data structure holding the comment details submitted by the user.

classes.name: Create.CommentData
classes.description: Contains the body text of the comment.

classes.name: Create.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the command ensuring the comment body is not empty.

classes.name: Create.Handler
classes.description: Handles the creation of a comment, including fetching the article, validating user, saving the comment to the database, and returning the created comment envelope.

methods.name: CommandValidator.constructor
methods.description: Initializes the validator and sets validation rules for Command.

methods.name: Handler.Handle
methods.description: Asynchronously processes the create comment command, interacting with the database and returning the result.
